instruction: I'm listening to a relaxing music track while studying. I'd like the song to continuously repeat so I don't have to manually restart it each time it finishes. Could you enable the loop/repeat function in VLC?

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
